verdict.rationale: Snowflake's Time Travel is well-documented: it allows querying historical data within a defined retention window (data updated/deleted since) and restoring accidentally or intentionally deleted objects such as tables, at individual or container level. This directly matches the story's requirements for both time-based querying and undrop/restore of dropped tables. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community corroboration of Time Travel specifically (community evidence covers other topics), and no detail on retention limits across edition tiers.
